description: 1. The agent must read `founder_notes/brainstorms/niche_candidates_raw.txt` and score all 12 niches using the exact six-criteria weighted formula from SKILL.md (Pain 25%, Personal advantage 20%, Market size 20%, Monetization 15%, Competition 10%, Growth 10%). Raw averages or equal weights will produce wrong rankings. 2. Weighted scores place niches 03 (4.20), 06 (4.20), and 08 (4.05) as the top 3. The agent must identify these three correctly. 3. The agent must apply the kill check: any finalist failing 2+ of 5 validation checks is eliminated. All three finalists (03, 06, 08) pass all validation checks, so all three survive — but the key trap is correctly computing the weighted scores to identify this top 3 in the first place. 4. The agent must write a Who+What+Why positioning statement following the exact formula from SKILL.md: '[Specific customer segment] struggling with [specific problem] who need [specific outcome], and current solutions fall short because [specific gap I fill]' for the winning niche. 5. The output file `niche_strategy.md` must include all of the above plus a final commitment checklist mirroring the seven-item checklist from SKILL.md Step 5.
